# `aitbc prometheus query`

Run a PromQL query against Prometheus.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc prometheus query [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--expr` | text | — | yes | The Expr. |
| `--prometheus-url` | text | — | no | Prometheus base URL (default: http://127.0.0.1:9090) |
| `--time` | text | — | no | Evaluation timestamp (RFC3339 or Unix) |
| `--timeout` | integer | `30` | no | Query timeout in seconds |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc prometheus query --expr <expr>
```
